name: Ibahernando (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ibahernando (a cross of Alcántara and ears of wheat on green).
history: The flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, formed of two triangles along the diagonal from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly, green next to the staff and white at the fly, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Ibahernando arms — cross of Alcántara and ears of wheat
